what: The review queue: what each scheduled reviewer reviews next, in order. The editor keeps `priority`; admin/build/review_queue.py turns it, the records and the articles into reviews/queue/<id>.json and .md, one dated batch a day for `days` days, at every release. A reviewer never gets the same article at the same text twice, and the lane refuses a second review of the same text.

priority.why: The editor's first ask: a fact check by more than one vendor before the article is called checked. ChatGPT reviewed it on 27 October (changes needed); Perplexity's is the independent second reading.
Published 27 October; numbers from a filing.
Published 26 October; a claim about what an event proves.

backlog: Newest first; each reviewer starts the backlog at a different article (the reviewers are dealt the backlog in turn), so between them the site is covered sooner, while every article in `priority` goes to every reviewer.
